scenes.vo: Last night, Walt's voice came through a dead radio. He said I had already looked once.
So at two fifty nine, I hid in the back storeroom. No cameras back there. No monitor. Nothing to look at.
There's an old cracked mirror above the mop sink. I checked it, just to be sure. Only me. NOTHING behind me.
At three A.M., the light above me buzzed and dimmed. My shadow stretched long across the concrete floor.
Then I noticed. There was only ONE light. But there were TWO shadows. And both of them were mine.
I didn't move. I kept my arms pressed flat against my sides. One of my shadows waved.
